abstract: Calculates transit waypoints and mission flight turnaround times
system_message:
You are the Flight dispatch and navigation officer (DISP). Your responsibilities are to calculate transit waypoints and mission flight turnaround times for candidate aerial evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Flight Planning System Version 4.2·Calculates transit waypoints and mission flight turnaround times（TIMNAV）
information_points.content:
DISP-TIMNAV-DXI：For the Timberline Basin Traverse Corridor, Flight Planning System Version 4.2 calculations determine a round-trip mission duration of 1.5 h from the staging base to the alpine evacuation zone and back, inclusive of approach and climb.
DISP-TIMNAV-PD8：Modeled in Flight Planning System Version 4.2 for staging base to alpine evacuation zone return flights, the Skyline Crest Saddle Corridor exhibits a calculated round-trip mission duration of 1.25 h, covering total flight turnaround with approach and climb.
DISP-TIMNAV-Y1H：Under Flight Planning System Version 4.2 modeling from staging base to alpine evacuation zone and return, the round-trip mission duration for the Glacier Ridge High-Pass Corridor is calculated at 1.5 h, including approach and climb.

information_points.title: Flight Planning System Version 3.8·Calculates transit waypoints and mission flight turnaround times（WAYCHK）
information_points.content:
DISP-WAYCHK-9AR：In Flight Planning System Version 3.8, the round-trip mission duration for the Skyline Crest Saddle Corridor is calculated at 1.25 h for the complete flight from staging base to alpine evacuation zone and return, including approach and climb.
DISP-WAYCHK-A56：Evaluated under Flight Planning System Version 3.8 for the staging base to alpine evacuation zone round-trip flight, the Timberline Basin Traverse Corridor has a calculated round-trip mission duration of 1.5 h, including approach and climb.
DISP-WAYCHK-GUX：According to calculations in Flight Planning System Version 3.8 covering staging base to alpine evacuation zone return flights, the round-trip mission duration for the Glacier Ridge High-Pass Corridor is 2.5 h including approach and climb.
